top_categories.workout_context: 404 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 404 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
404 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Yunnan's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.
Granfondo Yunnan's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 404 miles.
Granfondo Yunnan's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Granfondo Yunnan's mixed terrain actually does to you.
At Granfondo Yunnan, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Yunnan. Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Granfondo Yunnan, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.

race_overlay.heat: November in Mangshi to Jinghong, Yunnan, China (multi-city stage race) can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Granfondo Yunnan. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Ultra-distance fueling for 404 miles requires a practiced resupply plan built around confirmed course services and available commercial stops. Rehearse frequent carbohydrate intake on long rides, then scale the plan to intensity, sleep strategy, tolerance, and real food across the full event. Carry redundant fuel and avoid applying a short-event hourly target or fixed total-calorie estimate to a multi-day race.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Granfondo Yunnan. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Granfondo Yunnan requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Endurance, and HVLI Extended to prepare you for 404 miles of mixed terrain in Mangshi to Jinghong, Yunnan, China (multi-city stage race).
